ambiguities.source_text: Work out the Easter Week Number
ambiguities.ref:
easter_monday = compute Easter Monday for year
week1_monday = easter_monday - 11 weeks
week_num = ((dates - week1_monday) // 7) + 1
ambiguities.intent: Week 12 is the Monday-starting week containing Easter Sunday; week 1 begins 77 days before that Monday. Compute floor(day offset/7)+1.
